title: aider
intro: aider, one turn per `--message`, on an OpenAI chat-shaped provider through `OPENAI_API_BASE` and `OPENAI_API_KEY`. The chat history file lives in `$HI_DIR`, and later turns pass `--restore-chat-history`.
notes: Installed with pip into its own venv.
`--no-git` because the workspace is not a repository; drop it when it is, and aider will stage what it edits.
`openai/<model>` routes through litellm's OpenAI path; `anthropic/<model>` with `ANTHROPIC_API_BASE` (no `/v1`) for an Anthropic-shaped provider.
The litellm model-price fetch it logs at start is refused by the door and harmless; DeepSeek's chat model edits reliably in its `whole` format, which is why it is the default here.
caveat: aider has no shell tool: a task that asks it to run a command is answered with a script to run instead, so the turn ends at once and the steer finds nothing to interrupt. That is aider's shape, not a platform fault; cancel and the rest work.
